rationale: The source proposes a new shared, event-sourced work ledger. Research will validate the current wiki-plane contracts, concurrent SQLite behavior, federation and existing SDD integration surfaces before assessing the proposed design.

queries.intent: Map the wiki package before locating the project, store, federation and CLI contracts the ledger would extend.
Locate current project-root and storage-resolution APIs, including any linked-worktree handling already implemented.
Read the project configuration and root-resolution implementation after Q002 identifies its current API surface.
Locate SQLite connection, migration, transaction and edge-query behavior relevant to an independently rebuildable ledger index.
Read the SQLite store implementation to verify write-lock, migration and page-edge contracts.
Locate the current federation API and namespace configuration surface that a ledger plane could reuse.
Read the federation implementation to validate cross-plane identifiers and query composition limits.
Locate wiki-memory, MCP and CLI extension points for provenance-aware insights and ledger commands.
Read wiki tools to establish the existing tool input and output conventions a ledger tool must follow.
Read the wiki CLI to confirm how command groups and store access are registered.
Read installer and managed hook assets to verify current worktree and post-commit integration behavior.
Read managed hook assets to verify the current generated post-commit behavior and binary resolution.
Map SDD command documents that currently calculate readiness, start tasks, close tasks, review work, or land features.
Read the task-start command to identify task lifecycle emission and context-injection seams.
Read the next, review and done commands to verify how discovered work and merge gates would integrate.
Inspect recent history of the wiki package for prior concurrency, worktree or federation decisions that constrain the design.
Inspect recent history of SDD command and script assets to determine whether the proposed integration points are stable.

expected_findings: Verified shared-root behavior for normal checkouts and linked worktrees.
SQLite write, migration and query contracts relevant to ledger durability and recovery.
Federation and wiki-tool seams that can expose a separate ledger plane.
Current SDD command lifecycle and review surfaces that can emit or consume work-ledger records.
